The Accepted Invitation is part of final quest for the [[Bishop]]. Once you have started the quest by speaking to him, speak to the [[Inquisitor]] about the papers, but if you haven't completed his and [[Snake]]'s questline, he will turn you down. You can instead get the invitation from the [[Merchant]]. This can only be done once you have reached {{Happiness}} 90 with the [[Merchant]].
